about_the_game:
In Warlocks Nexus, your medieval realm faces an existential threat: an invasion from beyond. This isn't just about survival; it's about adaptation. Explore a fully destructible, voxel world, scavenge for resources, and craft your way through incursions. Master their otherworldly technologies, unlock dimensional portals, and turn the tide against your invaders by journeying to their own realms.

Key Features:-

Base building: 

Either take control of one of the many buildings in the world, or construct your perfect base wherever you choose to.

Traveling:

From the saddle of your chosen mount to the steady stroke of an oar across imposing oceans, diverse forms of travel await.

Farming:

Grow crops to sustain not only your survival, but your livestock.

Progress By doing:

You'll learn and advance through practice: Whether it's crafting superior Armor, wielding powerful weaponry, or specializing in diverse new fields, your skills grow with every task you complete.

Explore and Loot:

Take jobs from NPC's to gain access to the diverse points of interest around the world, exploring, looting and defending yourself from the inhabitants.

Crafting:

learn to craft the tools, weapons and armour that you need to survive this world.

Survive the weather: 

Experience snow storms, Rain storms or the blistering heat of the desert. Go Prepared and survive.

content_descriptors.notes: Unrealistic Mild cartoon violence, hitting chickens and fantasy creatures with various items including bows and axes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 3.0Ghz or faster multi core.
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: At least 4 gig, OpenGL 3.3, GeForce 8800, Radeon HD 4200.
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: *The game will perform better the more cores you have.
